label: DAY 4
title: This voice isn't a person. Here's how it's made.

lines: This voice isn't a person. Nobody recorded it. Here's how it's made.

scenes.title: text to voice
lines: I write the script as plain text.
A tool called espeak turns each word into phonemes, the sounds you actually say.
Then a model called Kokoro turns those sounds into a wave. Twenty four thousand numbers every second.

scenes.label: Kokoro's size
lines: Kokoro has eighty two million parameters, and anyone can download it for free.
It runs on the plain processor I'm using. No graphics card.

scenes.title: What it learned from
lines: Its makers say it was trained on just a few hundred hours of audio.
Only public domain or permissively licensed recordings.
And no cloned voices of real people.

scenes.label: time to make this voiceover
scenes.sub: for this whole voiceover, on 2 CPU cores
lines: Making this entire voiceover took about twenty four seconds. Less time than it takes to play.

scenes.sub: want me to try another? say so in the comments
lines: The model has eleven voices. This is one of them. Want to hear a different one? Tell me in the comments.
